title: hypodematium onustum
intro: Hypodematium onustum, commonly known as the Himalayan maidenhair fern, is a species of fern native to the Himalayas. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Hypodematium onustum include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help in easing coughs and relieving muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
